Workers Compensation Lawyer – Trusted Oakland Attorneys

Oakland Workers Compensation Lawyers With 80+ Years of Experience

Proven Results. Call (510) 257-4141 for a Free Consultation.

If you or someone you know has been hurt or injured while working, then speak with our award-winning workers compensation lawyers at the Franco Muñoz Law Firm. With over 80 combined years of rigorous advocacy and millions of dollars in settlements, our Oakland workers’ compensation lawyers have the skill, experience, and reputation to help you obtain the maximum benefits in your workers’ comp case. Our lawyers have successfully litigated cases through all aspects of a claim – from beginning to trial, to filing appeals before the Workers’ Compensation Appeals Board (WCAB). Our lawyers actually go to court and litigate in front of judges.

Why Choose Our Workers Compensation Lawyers?

Our attorneys understand the importance of providing you with the best legal representation. Our attorneys have served as speakers at national workers’ compensation conferences, have been quoted in major workers’ compensation publications, and have obtained some of the highest verdicts and settlements in California. We have recovered over $257 million for our clients: We know how to get results.

How Our Workers Compensation Lawyers Can Help

  • 80+ Years of Experience
  • Free, No-Obligation Consultation
  • Over $257 Million Recovered In Benefits
  • Voted Best Lawyers by Super Lawyers Magazine

Request a complimentary consultation today at (510) 257-4141.

Filing for Workers’ Compensation Benefits in Alameda County

Do you have a work-related injury? Do you need help navigating the California workers’ compensation system? Whether your employer was at fault for your injury or not, you may still be eligible to receive crucial benefits if your injury occurred during the course of your job.

Common Workers Compensation Cases We Handle

  • Auto Workers
  • Brain Injuries
  • Construction Accidents
  • Heart Injuries
  • Motor Vehicle Accidents
  • Union Workers

The benefits provided under the workers’ compensation system allow you to obtain critical medical treatment to help you recover from your workplace injury. If your injury is work-related, the insurance company may be required to cover your medical bills, lost wages, and additional compensation.

Frequently Asked Questions About Workers’ Compensation

  • What happens if my employer terminates me after I file a workers’ comp claim?
  • What are the next steps if the insurance carrier denies my case?
  • Can I pick my own workers’ comp doctor?
  • What rights do I have as an injured worker?
  • Can I bring both a workers' compensation claim and a civil claim?

Call Our Workers Compensation Lawyers in Oakland for a Free Consultation

Our attorneys provide a comprehensive, in-depth analysis of the facts of your case and develop a strategy to maximize your rights and benefits. Our attorneys have spoken at major legal conferences on how to properly handle a workers’ compensation claim, so you can trust us to effectively manage your case.

If you have questions about your rights, we would be happy to assist you. Contact our office at (510) 257-4141 for a free consultation!
